title: Run status (GET /sessions/<id>/runs/<runId>)
description: Polled every 2 s while the run is not complete. stdoutTail and stderrTail are the last limits.RUN_TAIL_LINES lines (at most limits.RUN_TAIL_MAX_BYTES bytes each); the full log is kept server-side (GET /sessions/<id>/runs/<runId>/log answers text/plain). `sec` counts up while running. status: queued, running, then done (rc 0), error (rc != 0), timeout (rc 124, the cell's timeoutSec) or stopped (the session was stopped).

kind.description: by extension: image png jpg jpeg gif webp svg; json; table csv tsv; markdown md; html; notebook ipynb; audio wav mp3 ogg; video mp4 webm; text txt log; binary everything else (.pt .bin .db .pkl). Binaries are never fetched and never offered for download.

fetched.description: previewable kinds are fetched under 5 MB per file and 25 MB per run; beyond the cap listed with fetched false

cmd.description: the command actually run (validated flags substituted)

step.description: a custom sequence: the step id running now

stdoutKind.description: classification of the whole stdout once complete: json when it parses as JSON, table for an aligned block of 3 or more lines; text otherwise (the text stays underneath). Carriage-return progress (tqdm) is collapsed to its last state in stdoutTail.

metrics.description: series parsed from `key: number` lines or the step's metric check, capped at 2000 points each, live while the run streams

producedFiles.description: files the run created or changed in the work tree (diff before and after), complete once the run is

probes.description: longRunning steps with an http_200 check: the probe's response, body cut to 64 KB
